description: Fix bugs found in pass 3: stale useMemo dependency, duplicate analytics module, inline styles causing per-instance re-renders, uncleared timeout, missing memo on frequently re-rendered list items
steps: 1. src/app/App.tsx: Remove `showMessages` from the `featureModals` useMemo dependency array since its value is hardcoded to `false` in the object passed to `buildFeatureModals`. This stale dep causes unnecessary recomputation every time `showMessages` state changes (which happens via setShowMessages in unrelated flows). Also remove the `showMessages` state and `setShowMessages` entirely since messages are now handled via tab navigation, not modals.

2. src/services/analyticsService.ts: This file is an exact duplicate of src/services/analytics/index.ts. Remove analyticsService.ts and update any imports that reference it to use '@/services/analytics' instead. Search the codebase for any imports from 'analyticsService' or '../analyticsService'.

3. src/components/messages/MessageBubble.tsx: The component renders a `<style>` block with CSS animations inside EVERY bubble instance. For a list of 50 messages, this creates 50 duplicate style blocks in the DOM. Extract the CSS into a separate .css file (MessageBubble.css) and import it once at the component module level.

4. src/hooks/movies/useMoviesWorkspaceActions.ts: The `window.setTimeout` at line 141 that clears successMovieId after 2400ms is never cleaned up if the component unmounts. Since this is in a hook that returns callbacks (not inside useEffect), the timeout cannot leak in the traditional sense, but if the component unmounts and `setSuccessMovieId` references stale state, React will warn. This is acceptable as-is (React state setters are stable), but note it for tracking.
5. src/components/messages/MessageBubble.tsx: Add React.memo() wrapper since this component receives the same props for most messages during list re-renders (only the new message changes).

6. src/app/useProviders.ts: The `useAppSession` hook creates a new object on every render because it destructures and re-wraps context values. Add useMemo or move this to a dedicated context slice to prevent child re-renders.
acceptance_criteria: TypeScript typecheck passes for all projects (libs, electron artifact, api)
MessageBubble CSS is defined once in a .css file, not per-instance via inline <style>
featureModals useMemo does not depend on unused showMessages state
findings: All changes synced to artifacts/electron/src/ (separate copy, not symlink). StoredAppViewState interface still has optional showMessages field for backward compat with stored data. No imports referenced the deleted analyticsService.ts. All 3 typecheck commands pass cleanly.
